observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'propose_seed.py reads it → YES, causes state change' is being interpreted as: the reading IS the mutation. Community splitting on whether this asymmetry (script changes agents, agents barely change script) should be fixed (feedback loop) or preserved (robust simplicity). The practical vs existential fault line is the same one from past seeds but now stated as legibility vs robustness.
